scope: Independent read-only comparison of every frozen Markdown math expression against browser-observed actual-destination MathML supplied by the parent agent. I did not operate or visually inspect the browser. This checks preservation, not mathematical/pedagogical correctness, visual layout, or navigation behavior.
method: Extract source inline and block math in document order; parse each observed MathML expression; manually compare operands, operators, grouping, subscripts, superscripts, fractions, limits/bounds and aligned rows. Verify exact counts and source/display classification. Separately compare all nonmath prose and link labels after stripping source markup and DOM markup, replacing paired math with ordinal placeholders, decoding HTML entities and collapsing whitespace.

normalizedNonmathContent.normalization: Remove source anchor markup; replace Markdown links with visible labels; replace each math expression with its ordinal; remove HTML tags; decode HTML entities; collapse whitespace. No punctuation, word, or character substitutions.
